about_the_game:
Nanami, a high school girl obsessed with mecha, is the kind of girl who secretly builds dangerous mecha every night, but ends up putting them away because she can't use them.

One night, the whole town is attacked by robots, causing panic!

Nanami is probably the only one who is excited, thinking, "I can finally let loose!"

name: Light Night Street Demo
short_description: Xbox controllers and XInput PC controllers are supported. You can play with PS5 controllers, PS4 controllers, and Switch Pro controllers by using a free tool called DS4Windows. Button display will be the same as that of the Xbox controller. This is a trial version that is still in development.
